title: Certificate: code/format.py
signature: render(request, profile, chosen, status, capacity) -> OutputRow
guarantees: amount_safe_to_pay, payment_plan amounts: plain numbers, no grouping, no trailing '.0'.
earliest_date_for_full_payment: capacity.earliest_full_date or '' ; equals request_date when status is affordable_now.
spending_changes_needed: 'none' or joined 'stop:<id>' / 'reduce_to:<id>:<amt>' in the candidate's order.

decision_explanation: one fixed template per outcome derived from all 25 samples; currency code + comma-grouped thousands; decimals only when non-zero; dates as '8 August 2025'; cites minimum_balance_to_keep verbatim.
